svg.title: Utopia Vinyl sales snapshot
svg.desc: Past 30 days, checked November 11, 2026 (Toronto time). 12 orders generated NT$9,560 in sales. Only orders with confirmed payment count. Cancelled, expired, and known test orders are excluded. Sales include recorded shipping; estimated month-end combined shipping is not added.

g.text: Sales count only orders with confirmed payment.
Cancelled, expired, and known test orders are excluded.
Sales include recorded shipping; estimated month-end combined shipping is not added.
Orders dashboard; paid figures cross-checked with Sales & Traffic
